# ledger

A family of the `nightseam.duplex/1` profile, declared in `model.json`, `protocol.json`.
The tiers it declares bring the built-in family `duplex`, imported implicitly.

## Types

### Account

An entity, identified by `id`. An account: identified, with a unique email and a bounded balance.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required | — |  |
| `email` | `string` | required | unique, matches `^[^@]+@[^@]+$` |  |
| `balance` | `integer` | required | min 0, max 1000000 |  |
| `tags` | array of `string` | required | length ≤ 8 |  |
| `opened_at` | `timestamp` | required | — |  |

### Transfer

A record. A transfer between two accounts, by their keys.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | reference to `Account` | required | — |  |
| `to` | reference to `Account` | required | — |  |
| `note` | `string` | optional | length ≥ 1, length ≤ 140 |  |
